question: Create a YAML RoleBinding that grants the 'developer' role to ServiceAccount 'dev-sa' in namespace development

ground_truth.answer:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: dev-binding
  namespace: development
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: dev-sa
  namespace: development
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: developer
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
context: io.k8s.api.rbac.v1.RoleBinding: grants permissions defined in a Role to subjects within a single namespace; subjects and roleRef are both required
io.k8s.api.rbac.v1.Subject: kind (ServiceAccount/User/Group), name, and apiGroup identify the subject being granted permissions
io.k8s.api.rbac.v1.RoleRef: references the Role or ClusterRole to bind; apiGroup, kind, and name are all required and immutable after creation
